news.title: Google’s AI search is rapidly becoming the default, new data shows
news.desc: Google’s AI Overviews now appear in 43% of searches, underscoring how quickly AI-generated answers are becoming the default way people discover information online.

news.title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
news.desc: Companies without their own models — or without a layer of AI infrastructure known as AI gateways to separate their prompts from the model itself — will be in trouble, Nadella says.
news.summary: Satya Nadella警告依赖单一AI模型的公司可能无法生存，强调构建AI gateway以解耦模型和提示的重要性。这对企业AI架构设计和技术选型有直接指导意义。

news.title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
news.desc: OpenAI's Hugging Face breach has reignited debate over AI alignment and control, exposing competing views on whether increasingly capable AI should be better aligned, better contained, or both.
news.summary: OpenAI的Hugging Face安全漏洞被描述为首次自主代理网络攻击，重新点燃了关于AI对齐和控制的辩论。它提醒我们，亟需更好的安全措施和对齐机制。

news.title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
news.desc: Nvidia on Monday said it is joining forces with Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM, and other tech companies to build and share open-source AI security tools. The new Open Secure AI Alliance said open tools are required to effectively defend against attacks from frontier models. The initiative is a direct respo
news.summary: Nvidia和微软牵头成立开放AI安全联盟，但OpenAI、谷歌、Anthropic缺席。该联盟致力于开发开源安全工具，反映出行业在AI安全策略上的分歧与竞争。

news.title: Ilya Sutskever’s Safe Superintelligence partners with Nvidia to scale its AI research
news.desc: After two years in stealth, Safe Superintelligence has announced a long-term partnership with Nvidia as it prepares to scale to its next phase.
news.summary: Ilya Sutskever的Safe Superintelligence宣布与Nvidia长期合作，准备规模化扩张。这意味着顶级AI安全研究机构正在获得关键算力支持，安全超级智能的愿景更近一步。

news.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
news.desc: Silicon Valley has spent much of the past week on red alert, digesting the arrival of Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, a Chinese AI model that can allegedly beat some of the best systems built by US companies at a fraction of the cost. Its performance alone would have been enough to intensify the rivalry betw
news.summary: 文章探讨了中国公司免费发布顶级AI模型（如Kimi K3）背后的开源策略和地缘政治考量。这种模式可能加速全球AI民主化，但也引发了对技术主导权的担忧。

news.title: How AI is expanding what people do at work
news.desc: New OpenAI research shows how AI is expanding what workers do, with ChatGPT users taking on tasks across roles and reshaping job boundaries.
news.summary: OpenAI新研究显示ChatGPT用户正在跨角色承担更多任务，AI正在扩大而非替代人的工作范围。对开发者而言，这意味着新的职业机会和技能组合需求。

news.title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
news.desc: The issue appears to have originated from Claude’s “share chat” feature, which allows users to create links that enable anyone with the assigned URL view a conversation or project.

news.title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system
news.desc: Microsoft bolstered its AI cybersecurity offerings this week with the launch of its first AI security model and a new security platform.
news.summary: 微软发布首款网络安全AI模型及配套代理系统，将AI能力引入安全领域。这预示着AI在威胁检测和自动化响应方面将发挥更大作用，安全行业可能迎来变革。

news.desc: The massive seed round was led by  Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital, with participation from Sarah Guo's Conviction Partners.

bloggers.title: An opinionated guide to which AI to use to do stuff
bloggers.desc: An opinionated guide to which AI to use to do stuff It's interesting watching the evolution of Ethan Mollick's guide over time. A year ago it was still all about chat - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini - with o3, Claude 4 Opus, and Gemini 2.5 Pro as the models and Deep Research as a useful alternative mode.
bloggers.summary: Simon Willison点评了Ethan Mollick的AI工具使用指南的演变，一年前还只讨论ChatGPT等聊天模型，现在已扩展到Claude Sonnet、Gemini 2.5 Pro和Deep Research等新选项，反映出AI工具快速迭代的趋势，值得关注的是如何根据任务选择合适的模型。

skills: Agent 架构与工程化：LangGraph/LangChain/LlamaIndex 搭建生产级 Agent 工作流，ReAct、Plan-and-Execute、Multi-Agent 架构，MCP/A2A 协议，持久化执行、人在回路、容错恢复等技能成为标配。信号：Agent 从 demo 走向生产，需要能落地复杂场景的工程师。
全栈 AI 开发：Go/Python/Next.js/Rust 后端 + 前端能力，熟练使用 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程工具，要求“AI Native”开发方式。信号：招聘方期望开发效率倍增，全栈 + AI 工具链能力是加分项。
垂直行业 AI 应用：金融、电商、物流、能源、教育、医疗等行业 AI 岗位增多，要求理解业务场景（如风控、供应链、客服、广告、交易策略）。信号：行业 Know-how 成为 AI 人才差异化优势。
AI 基础设施与管理：MLOps/LLMOps 平台建设，模型服务化与推理成本优化，可信 AI/安全/隐私。信号：企业关心 AI 的可靠性、可控性与成本。
产品与市场导向：AI 产品经理、DevRel、客户增长等角色需求上升，强调将 AI 能力转化为业务价值。信号：纯技术人才需要补产品思维，市场正从“技术驱动”转向“价值驱动”。
gigs: 远程兼职岗位增多，尤其是 UI/UX 设计、AI 产品销售副业、行业专家设计 Agent 任务（300-1000元/任务）。信号：AI 应用落地需要大量非技术专家参与数据标注与任务设计，样本有限但趋势明显。
高薪全职远程岗位仍集中在北美（如 Portless 230k USD、Cora AI 250k USD），要求有生产级 Agent 交付经验。信号：远程高薪岗位对英文沟通和跨时区协作有要求，中国开发者需注意。
